name: Brain and Cognitive Sciences (BCS) PhD
department: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences / McGovern & Picower Institutes
discipline_tag: Neuroscience, Psychology & Cognitive Science, Machine Learning / AI
intl_waiver_event: MIT Graduate Admissions Application Fee Waiver (Available to international applicants demonstrating financial hardship)
toefl_det: IELTS: 7.0+ / TOEFL iBT: 100+; DET: Not Accepted
fee_waiver_info: MIT Graduate Application Fee Waiver available via OGE Office: https://oge.mit.edu/graduate-admissions/applications/fee-waivers/
intl_student_stats: Cohort size ~15-20, approx 30% international students. Full 5-year fellowship and stipend guaranteed. Source: https://bcs.mit.edu/academic-program/graduate
faculty_match: Robert Desimone, Nancy Kanwisher, James DiCarlo, Josh Tenenbaum
notes: Rotations in 3 labs during year 1. World-leading integration of computational neuroscience, cognitive AI, and systems neurobiology.

name: Neurosciences Interdepartmental Program (IDP) PhD
department: School of Medicine & Wu Tsai Neurosciences Institute
intl_waiver_event: Stanford Biosciences Fee Waiver (Available to international applicants demonstrating hardship)
toefl_det: TOEFL iBT: 100+ required (minimum subscores: R:20, L:20, S:20, W:20); DET: Not Accepted
fee_waiver_info: Stanford Biosciences Fee Waiver and School of Medicine ADVANCE program: https://biosciences.stanford.edu/how-to-apply/application-fee-waivers/
intl_student_stats: Accepts ~12-16 students/yr, ~25% international. Full tuition + health insurance + stipend ($53k+/yr) for all 5 years. Source: https://med.stanford.edu/neurogradprogram.html
faculty_match: Surya Ganguli, Dan Yamins, Shaul Druckmann, Karl Deisseroth, Liqun Luo
notes: Three 10-week lab rotations in Year 1. Strongest computational neuroscience community bridging engineering, AI, and experimental physiology.

name: Program in Neuroscience (PiN) PhD
department: Harvard Medical School / Kenneth C. Griffin Graduate School of Arts and Sciences
discipline_tag: Neuroscience, Biological Sciences, Computational Biology & Bioinformatics
intl_waiver_event: Harvard GSAS Application Fee Waiver (International applicants eligible to request inside portal)
toefl_det: TOEFL iBT: 100+ (subscores: 26+ speaking strongly recommended); DET: Not Accepted
fee_waiver_info: Harvard GSAS Application Fee Waiver application available inside application portal prior to deadline: https://gsas.harvard.edu/admissions/apply/application-fee
intl_student_stats: Cohort ~15-20 students, accepts international applicants with equal funding guarantee (tuition + $50k+ stipend). Source: https://pin.hms.harvard.edu/
faculty_match: Haim Sompolinsky, Jan Drugowitsch, Cengiz Pehlevan, Rachel Wilson, Florian Engert
notes: Home of the Center for Brain Science (CBS) and Kempner Institute for Natural & Artificial Intelligence. Exceptional theoretical neuroscience group.

name: Biomedical Engineering PhD (Weldon School)
department: Weldon School of Biomedical Engineering (College of Engineering)
intl_waiver_type: Virtual Info Session Free Code (Intl Eligible)
intl_waiver_event: Purdue Engineering Virtual Graduate Showcase (Late September - October). Attendees receive a 100% Free Application Fee Waiver Code valid for international applicants.
fee_waiver_info: Purdue Engineering Virtual Graduate Showcase provides 100% Free Application Fee Waiver Code for all attendees including international students! Link: https://engineering.purdue.edu/Engr/Academics/Graduate/showcase
intl_student_stats: Cohort size ~20-25 students, ~35-40% international. Full fellowship/RA stipend ($34,000/yr). Source: https://engineering.purdue.edu/BME/Academics/Graduate
faculty_match: Pedro Irazoqui, Vitaliy Rayz, Jackie Linnes, Chi Hwan Lee
notes: Pedro Irazoqui: implantable wireless neuromodulation devices for epilepsy and bioelectronics; Chi Hwan Lee: stick-on electronic sensors for physiological monitoring.

name: PhD in Physiology, Development and Neuroscience (PDN)
department: Department of Physiology, Development and Neuroscience (School of Biological Sciences)
intl_waiver_event: Cambridge University Postgraduate Admissions International Fee Waiver
toefl_det: IELTS Academic: 7.5+ (minimum 7.0 in each subscore) or TOEFL iBT: 107+ (minimum 25 in each subscore); DET: Not Accepted
requires_master: No (First Class UK Bachelor's or international equivalent accepted)
fee_waiver_info: Cambridge Postgraduate Admissions Fee Waiver available for eligible candidates: https://www.postgraduate.study.cam.ac.uk/how-apply/application-fee/application-fee-waiver
intl_student_stats: Cohort size ~30-35 across PDN, ~40% international. Gates Cambridge, Cambridge Trust, and MRC full scholarships available. Source: https://www.pdn.cam.ac.uk/graduate-studies
faculty_match: Ole Paulsen, Timothy O'Leary, Wolfram Schultz, Bill Harris
notes: Home of Brain Prize and Nobel laureates; Timothy O'Leary: homeostatic plasticity and computational biophysics; Wolfram Schultz: dopamine reward prediction error.

name: Neuroscience PhD Program (Centre for Discovery Brain Sciences)
department: Centre for Discovery Brain Sciences (College of Medicine and Veterinary Medicine)
intl_waiver_event: 100% Free Application ($0 Fee for All Applicants Worldwide)
app_fee: Free ($0 Application Fee for All Applicants)
toefl_det: TOEFL iBT: 92+; IELTS: 6.5; DET: Not Accepted
requires_master: Master's or 1st Class UK Bachelor's equivalent
fee_waiver_info: Application is 100% Free for all applicants worldwide: https://www.ed.ac.uk/discovery-brain-sciences
intl_student_stats: Cohort size ~20-25 students, ~45% international. Wellcome Trust & Precision Medicine DTP provide full funding. Source: https://www.ed.ac.uk/discovery-brain-sciences/postgraduate-study
faculty_match: David Wyllie, Matthew Nolan, Tara Spires-Jones, Ian Duguid
notes: Matthew Nolan: Grid cell computation and neural circuits of spatial memory; Tara Spires-Jones: Synapse loss and Alzheimer's disease pathology.
